issues: 480×270 设计坐标放大，chip 字只有 ~12 设计 px，整组只占画面中间一小块
灰底 + 小号「BILLING CYCLE」眉题，没有问题、没有产品语境
没有触发者，灰闪和反黑像是自己发生的
收束后的算式行是一行小字，结果没有分量，结尾不成画面
changes: look 换 porcelain 冷白 + 钴蓝，按 1080p 原生重排：84px 问句「How would you like to pay?」+ 96px 高实体 chip（36px 字、发丝线、内高光、两层软阴影），主体占画宽 ~62%
新增光标 swift 弧线移向目标并按下；单帧灰闪 → 5f 线性反黑（墨黑 + ✓ 长出）→ sin 回弹 0.04，其余 chip 降到 18% 位置锁死，命门参数保持
选中 chip 底下亮一圈极淡钴蓝落地光（只给主角一次），收束时上移 + 缩到 0.88 + 回中线，阴影随抬升变深
结果段做成价格海报：原价 $42.00 升起后被划线划掉退灰 → 现价 $34.44 180px 逐字升起 → 钴蓝「Save 18%」overshoot 弹出
issuesEn: Built in 480×270 design units and scaled up; chip labels are ~12 design px and the group occupies a small patch in the middle
Grey background with a small "BILLING CYCLE" eyebrow; no question and no product context
There's no actor: the grey flash and blackout seem to happen by themselves
After the collapse the formula is one small line of text; the result has no weight and the end isn't a composed frame
changesEn: Porcelain cool white with cobalt, re-laid natively at 1080p: an 84px question "How would you like to pay?" and 96px-tall solid chips (36px type, hairline, top highlight, two-layer soft shadow) spanning ~62% of the width

A cursor arcs in and presses the target; one-frame grey flash → 5f linear blackout (ink navy, a check grows in) → 0.04 sine pulse, others drop to 18% with positions locked; the signature parameters are unchanged
A faint cobalt floor glow lights under the selected chip (once, hero only); on collapse it rises, scales to 0.88 and recentres while its shadow deepens
The result is a price poster: $42.00 rises then gets struck through and greys out → $34.44 rises char by char at 180px → a cobalt "Save 18%" pill pops with overshoot
